title.zh: Block Seeks Federal Charter to Anchor Bitcoin Custody in National Banking System
title.en: Block Seeks Federal Charter to Anchor Bitcoin Custody in National Banking System

current_state.zh: Block is seeking a federal banking charter to bring its Bitcoin custody operations under the national banking framework, a move that would deepen institutional integration of crypto custody.
